scope: Four trained main checkpoints, independent of the Phase 0 default-model snapshot matrix.
method: Both legs use the same configuration digest, compressed checkpoint digest, physical V100 UUID and PyTorch version. The external atomic features repeat in the same order. The training step differentiates sum(E squared) + sum(Fa squared) with respect to the model weights. A local native reference validates each E, Fa and every active parameter gradient returned through the ordinary compiled entry point. Each input is additionally compared across the two source checkouts under the original trained parameter names. Ratios exist only for numerically validated measurements on both sides.
training_dispatch: MACE FF04 uses native forces inside the ordinary compiled training call. The other three trained checkpoints select the compiled coordinate VJP.
